info.name: Task Scheduler API
info.description: Collection for testing the Task Scheduler API

request.description: Get a specific task by ID

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Daily API Health Check",
    "description": "Check the health of our API every day at 8 AM",
    "taskType": "REST_CALL",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 8 * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 3,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
    "restTaskConfig": {
        "url": "https://api.example.com/health",
        "method": "GET",
        "headers": "{\"Accept\": \"application/json\"}",
        "timeout": 30,
        "authType": "BEARER",
        "tokenEndpoint": "https://auth.example.com/token",
        "clientId": "my-client-id",
        "clientSecret": "my-client-secret"
    }
}

{
    "name": "Weekly SOAP Service Call",
    "description": "Call the SOAP service every Monday at 7 AM",
    "taskType": "SOAP_CALL",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 7 ? * MON",
    "maxRetries": 2,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 120,
    "soapTaskConfig": {
        "wsdlUrl": "https://soap.example.com/service?wsdl",
        "operation": "getCustomerData",
        "namespace": "http://example.com/soap",
        "soapAction": "http://example.com/soap/getCustomerData",
        "requestXml": "<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\" xmlns:exam=\"http://example.com/soap\">\n   <soapenv:Header/>\n   <soapenv:Body>\n      <exam:getCustomerDataRequest>\n         <exam:customerId>12345</exam:customerId>\n      </exam:getCustomerDataRequest>\n   </soapenv:Body>\n</soapenv:Envelope>",
        "authType": "BASIC",
        "timeout": 60,
        "username": "soapuser",
        "password": "soappass",
        "customHeaders": "{\"SOAPAction\": \"http://example.com/soap/getCustomerData\"}"
    }
}

{
    "name": "Daily Log Cleanup",
    "description": "Clean up log files every day at midnight",
    "taskType": "LOW_PLATFORM_BATCH",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 0 * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 1,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 300,
    "lowPlatformBatchConfig": {
        "jobName": "log-cleanup",
        "command": "cleanup-logs.sh",
        "parameters": "--days 7 --verbose",
        "workingDirectory": "/opt/scripts",
        "timeout": 600,
        "runAsUser": "admin",
        "onSuccess": "notify-success.sh",
        "onFailure": "notify-failure.sh"
    }
}

request.description: Create a new Low Platform Batch task

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Weekly Mainframe MQ Job",
    "description": "Submit a job to the mainframe via MQ every Sunday at 11 PM",
    "taskType": "HIGH_PLATFORM_BATCH",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 23 ? * SUN",
    "maxRetries": 2,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 180,
    "highPlatformBatchConfig": {
        "endpointType": "MQ",
        "transactionId": "MQJOB001",
        "payload": "JOB CARD DATA\nEXEC PGM=WEEKLY\nINPUT DD *\nPARAM1=VALUE1\nPARAM2=VALUE2\n/*",
        "credentials": "{\"username\": \"mquser\", \"password\": \"mqpass\"}",
        "timeout": 300,
        "channel": "SYSTEM.DEF.SVRCONN",
        "queue": "JOB.SUBMIT.QUEUE"
    }
}

request.description: Create a new High Platform Batch task using MQ

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Monthly Mainframe API Job",
    "description": "Submit a job to the mainframe via API on the 1st of each month",
    "taskType": "HIGH_PLATFORM_BATCH",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 1 1 * ?",
    "maxRetries": 3,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 240,
    "highPlatformBatchConfig": {
        "endpointType": "API",
        "transactionId": "APIJOB002",
        "payload": "{\"jobName\": \"MONTHLY\", \"parameters\": {\"MONTH\": \"CURRENT\", \"MODE\": \"FULL\"}}",
        "credentials": "{\"username\": \"apiuser\", \"password\": \"apipass\"}",
        "timeout": 300,
        "host": "mainframe-api.example.com",
        "port": "443",
        "sslCertPath": "/etc/certs/mainframe-api.crt"
    }
}

request.description: Create a new High Platform Batch task using API

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Hourly Kafka Message",
    "description": "Send a message to Kafka topic every hour",
    "taskType": "MESSAGING",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 * * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 3,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
    "messagingTaskConfig": {
        "brokerType": "KAFKA",
        "destinationName": "hourly-updates",
        "messagePayload": "{\"timestamp\": \"${now}\", \"type\": \"HOURLY_UPDATE\", \"data\": {\"source\": \"scheduler\"}}",
        "connectionUrl": "kafka.example.com:9092",
        "authType": "BASIC",
        "headers": "{\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}",
        "deliveryMode": "PERSISTENT",
        "retryPolicy": "{\"maxRetries\": 3, \"retryInterval\": 5000}"
    }
}

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Daily RabbitMQ Message",
    "description": "Send a message to RabbitMQ queue every day at 6 AM",
    "taskType": "MESSAGING",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 6 * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 3,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 60,
    "messagingTaskConfig": {
        "brokerType": "RABBITMQ",
        "destinationName": "daily-reports",
        "messagePayload": "{\"timestamp\": \"${now}\", \"type\": \"DAILY_REPORT\", \"data\": {\"reportDate\": \"${yesterday}\"}}",
        "connectionUrl": "amqp://rabbitmq.example.com:5672",
        "authType": "BASIC",
        "headers": "{\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\", \"priority\": \"high\"}",
        "deliveryMode": "PERSISTENT",
        "retryPolicy": "{\"maxRetries\": 5, \"retryInterval\": 10000}"
    }
}
